status: Scenario handles of the candidate fixed-root identity profile. Handle ID-NN is the registered conformance case C-id-NN (profile note §10); 'conformance' is that case's harness status (covers, partial or pending) and a test in internal/conformance keeps it equal to what the tests declare. The profile is not active: tests check the rc/2 reader, the admission adapter and the reference model, not a consumer, and a case is covered only when its whole required outcome is checked end to end at those layers with signed evidence (profile note §10). Schema vectors are shape checks only.

scenarios.remaining: Covered by internal/resolve:TestDualDifferential: legacy goldens, the P-01 property fixtures, a task corpus and the wire-format vectors read under the default store and the dual-major store with the same ids, statuses, refusals and every resolver answer. The dual reader is a candidate store option; no production caller wires it.

Covered at the evaluator: the published signed rc/2 act (both algorithms) is eligible through Admit and the candidate actor evaluator, with I, G, D and the root lineage in its basis. No production reader wires the evaluator: the profile is not active.
Require exact root and delegate lineage pins; schema checks inception syntax only.

scenarios.scenario: Grant alone cannot attribute raw statements
scenarios.remaining: Model/reader attribution test, including preexisting raw history.
Self-grant/actor shapes checked; root/delegate signature and referent bindings require authority evaluation.

scenarios.scenario: One key with grants for multiple identities
scenarios.remaining: Single actor object checked; test explicit principal selection and no cross-principal amendment.

scenarios.scenario: Missing dependencies or unsupported root operation
scenarios.remaining: Pure model and integration must retain and propagate exact unknown dependencies.

scenarios.scenario: Known cut with missing ancestry or prefix
scenarios.remaining: Authenticated root relevance and blocked positive grant required.
Limitation fixture must allow evidence-relative eligibility without claiming freshness.

Raw events stay rc/1 and are seen by old keylog; identity history exception requires model/consumer integration. The resolver counts an identity-context statement by actor eligibility with its key's bare-key status shown beside it (D-1108-2), through a test-only evaluator; no production reader wires the real one.
Set-based ancestry closure including merges; signed wire binding still required.

scenarios.scenario: Multiple cuts / wider cuts / null cut
scenarios.remaining: Mandatory nullable prefix syntax checked; intersection and permutation semantics belong to model.
Do not drop authenticated control on syntax/lineage failures and falsely pass the grant.

scenarios.scenario: New grant cannot relabel old bytes
scenarios.remaining: Actor/grant signature binding checked generically; full cut/new-grant authority fixture required.
Pure evaluator and consumer noninterference, holding all other evidence fixed.
Model accumulation and complete root-lineage fork/merge checks.

scenarios.scenario: Root events in correct versus rival lineage
scenarios.remaining: Covered at the evaluator: the published root revoke_key retires I in both algorithms; placement by prev whatever the merges, the same event on a proved rival inception (no effect) and an unplaceable event (unknown) are checked with synthetic keys. No production reader wires the evaluator: the profile is not active.

scenarios.scenario: Root lost but public evidence held
scenarios.remaining: Authority must not depend on private-key availability; custody recovery is separate.
Permission syntax tested; registered field dispatch and effective authorization need model/integration.

Covered at the evaluator over signed evidence (EIP-191 root, Ed25519 worker): amend:false publishes in scope, an act carrying amends (own record or another delegate's) is denied by scope, a missing amend is an invalid grant. No production reader wires the evaluator: the profile is not active.

The amendment DAG, concurrent cross-key amendments (contested, no tiebreak) and reconciliation run in the resolver behind the actor hook with a test-only evaluator; the same over signed rc/2 evidence needs the dual-major reader.

scenarios.scenario: Wrong principal/content or missing amendment target
scenarios.remaining: Wrong principal, wrong content, an ineligible target and a missing target run in the resolver behind the actor hook with a test-only evaluator; the same over signed rc/2 evidence needs the dual-major reader.

scenarios.scenario: Cut preserves claim but loses anchor
scenarios.remaining: Pending: no test. Needs the time consumer to report authority and time quality separately; not built while the profile is not active. Time consumer must preserve separate authority and time-quality outcomes.
Real synthetic signatures show distinct statement ids and same v2 body id; threshold evaluation remains.

scenarios.scenario: Two delegates of one I count once
scenarios.remaining: Typed/duplicate-subject syntax checked; effective subject deduplication remains.

scenarios.scenario: Missing identity authority is never root-key fallback
scenarios.remaining: Carrier-key mapping is rejected; typed identity slot needs authenticated I/G, never root signature fallback.

scenarios.scenario: Mixed raw/identity slots with same signer
scenarios.remaining: Distinct signature contexts and shared body tested; one subject per approval and effective slot counting remain.

scenarios.scenario: Complete typed controller changes and merges
scenarios.remaining: Reject untyped/duplicate/partial/unsatisfiable authority shapes; predecessor/merge authority evaluation remains. Supersedes obsolete carrier-mapping wording.
Pending: no test. Needs the resource consumer (approval withdrawal ordering); not built while the profile is not active. Consumer ordering and cross-delegate exclusion tests required.

Pending: no test. Needs the resource consumer (contested propagation to dependants); not built while the profile is not active. Propagate contested/unresolved authority to affected resource descendants.

Policy syntax tested. Principal-following selection of an identity now runs through the actor-eligibility seam with a test-only evaluator (eligible claims only; a bare worker-key statement is never I's; undecided or amending claims read unknown). Exact pins to identity-context statements, the amendment DAG, and the real evaluator adapter remain.

scenarios.scenario: Invalid/missing exact pin and policy conflicts
scenarios.remaining: Conflicting selector syntax checked; through the seam, an undecided or denied claim of I is never substituted (unknown / not met). Production preflight exit 2 and the real evaluator adapter remain.

scenarios.scenario: Trust purpose boundaries / received policy injection
scenarios.remaining: Closed local policy syntax checked; through the seam (policy.TrustsStatement, the resolver's one trust question) an identity entry trusts only statements a test-only evaluator calls eligible for I, never a bare worker-key statement, with purposes and content targets separate. Targets apply to the content being judged: a reference (corroborates/refutes/retracts `of`, describes of a statement) is followed one hop, and an unresolved one reads unknown, never trusted or not trusted (policy.TrustsTarget; the pull trust floor). The real evaluator adapter and the received-policy-injection half remain.

Mandatory counting unit checked. Through the resolver with a test-only evaluator: eligible submissions deduplicated by identity, bare submissions never identity votes, denied and undecided actors named and not counted. The real evaluator over rc/2 task statements needs rc/2 task kinds (read unsupported today) and a registered task-contract profile with typed identity issuers.

scenarios.scenario: Key counting cannot bypass actor authority
scenarios.remaining: Through the resolver with a test-only evaluator: an identity submission with denied or undecided actor authority is not counted for its key; bare-key submissions keep the bare-key gate. The real evaluator over rc/2 task statements needs rc/2 task kinds (read unsupported today).

Unchanged reader: wire/keylog retain rc/2 unverified, and every resolver view answers without a panic on the signed vectors plus rc/2 resource/task/invalid lines (internal/resolve:TestDualViewsSurviveCandidateBytes). Dual-major reader built as a candidate store option; under it rc/2 resource/task kinds stay unsupported and an actor line never counts as its key. Remaining: a production reader that wires it (pull, gates, CLI views) and the critical registry.
Concrete schema negatives and both algorithms tested; full production critical registry still disabled.
Pin production evidence-snapshot serialization and test caches/replay; not established by this harness.
PAE/depth syntax bounds and the model evaluation caps are tested; the production exit 3 mapping needs a command.

Pending: no test. A recorded custody drill (profile §8): restore of the root key file from backup, and a compromised operational host; not a unit test. No drill is recorded and no signer adapter is claimed.

scenarios.scenario: Marker without actor / actor without marker
scenarios.remaining: Raw context schema/crypto checked; actual mixed controller semantics and production reader integration remain.

scenarios.scenario: Decide grant is not beneficiary role
scenarios.remaining: Typed complete task roles checked; concrete contract profile and beneficiary enforcement required.
Explicit intent syntax checked; same-actor/edition continuity and irreversible withdrawal require model/consumer integration.

scenarios.scenario: Authorized unknown amendment versus outsider DoS
scenarios.remaining: Outsider half at the model; an authorized amendment naming a missing target makes I's current view unknown (an exact pin still selects the eligible target) and an unbound outsider changes nothing in the resolver behind the actor hook with a test-only evaluator; signed rc/2 end to end needs the dual-major reader.

Grant breadth at the model (amend:true identity-wide; amend:"own" only the acting key's records of the identity, over signed evidence); the resolver applies an eligible cross-key amendment with a test-only evaluator. Issuer UI acknowledgment and signed rc/2 end to end through the dual-major reader remain.
